package.name: bfmc_v2x
package.description: V2X localisation and cooperative driving logic for a BFMC-style 1:10 vehicle. Pure Python: no rclpy, no Gazebo, no simulator. The ROS nodes in bfmc_v2x_ros are thin adapters over this package, which is what lets the filter and the right-of-way rules be tested in milliseconds.
